features.name: Enhanced Power BI Sales App
features.description: An updated Power BI application for sales in version 26.1 that expands on the previous version by adding seven new reports and updating existing reports covering the full sales lifecycle, profitability analysis, demographics, and AI-assisted insights.
features.status_evidence_quote: the enhanced powerbi app for sales that we ship in version 26.1 as you can see we have seven new reports coming

features.name: Opportunity Overview Report
features.description: New report providing analysis of opportunities with KPIs, value by status, sales cycle view, funnel by stages, and geographic representation with estimated value by location.

features.name: Sales Quote Overview Report
features.description: Enhanced report showing sales quotes by customer including profit analysis, sales staff tracking, and quote trends over time to provide a holistic view of quoting activity.

features.name: Return Order Overview Report
features.description: New report tracking return orders showing wasted sales amounts, missing profit opportunities, which customers return most, reasons for returns, and return trends over time.

features.name: Sales by Customer Report with Pareto Analysis
features.description: Enhanced report showing customer profitability with new Pareto analysis visual that identifies which customer segments generate specific percentages of profit, plus profit margin metrics and geographic sales breakdown.

features.name: Sales by Item Report with Category and Profitability Analysis
features.description: Updated report with new visuals showing sales by item category over time to identify seasonality patterns and a bubble chart visual for item profitability comparing sales quantity against sales amount with profit margin indicators.

features.name: Sales by Salesperson Report with Profitability Metrics
features.description: Enhanced existing report showing sales metrics, profit, margin by salesperson, opportunities overview in the CRM module, and bubble chart analysis of salesperson profitability to evaluate sales staff performance beyond revenue.

features.name: Sales Overview Page with Breakdown Visualization
features.description: Updated existing report showing top five customers and sales amount by salesperson with breakdown display separating negative amounts from revenue-generating amounts.

features.name: Sales by Location Report with Map
features.description: Existing report enhanced with map visualization showing geographic distribution of customers and revenue, with bubble size indicating sales amounts by geography.

features.name: Sales Demographics Report
features.description: New report analyzing customer and sales composition by geography showing customer count by location in map format, sales metrics by amount and profit by item category and customer posting group.

features.name: Sales Decomposition Report with AI-Assisted Analysis
features.description: New report using statistical data mining techniques to analyze sales contributors through a tree structure, showing automated identification of high or low value contributors across different dimensions like location and salesperson.
caveats: Uses proven data mining techniques rather than generative AI

features.name: Key Sales Influencers Report
features.description: New report using statistical model to provide AI-assisted insights answering questions about what influences document types, such as what characteristics influence a document to be a sales invoice versus credit memo or return shipment, with likelihood multipliers and impact analysis.

features.name: Sales Segmentation Report
features.description: AI-powered segmentation of sales data finding significant segments based on factors like location, product, and salesperson with AI-generated learn more details and segment exploration capabilities.

features.name: Sales Analytics Documentation and Guidance
features.description: Comprehensive documentation covering Power BI KPIs, ad hoc analysis with data analysis on lists and queries, and legacy and new Excel reports for sales, accessible via documentation links.
